ORDINANCE VI OF 2007
ORDINANCE VI OF 2007
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2007
An Ordinance further to
amend the Balochistan
Local
Government Ordinance, 2001.
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary
7th April, 2007]
No.Legis:122/Law/2000-XIII, dated
7-4-2007.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan
on 24th March, 2007, is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas, it is expedient further to amend
the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 2001
(XVIII), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas, the President of Pakistan
has, in consultation with Prime Minister, accorded sanction to the said
amendments in the Balochistan Local Government
Ordinance, 2001, in terms of clause (2) of Article 268 of the Constitution of
Islamic Republic of Pakistan. 1973.
And whereas, the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor is satisfied that the circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the
Governor of the Province of Balochistan is pleased to
make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan
Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007.
(2) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect from 16th February, 2007.

Amendment  of  the  First  Schedule,  Ordinance  XVIII of 2001
